With AI built on decades of Salesforce expertise in customer experience, every automated interaction feels personal — so the relationships you've worked hard to build only get stronger.

With AI that's built on Salesforce's enterprise-grade security and privacy standards, your customers data is in safe hands.

### Happier customers in minutes.
Get customers answers faster, and leave them feeling taken care of — with email-to-case, automated workflows, and AI built on decades of Salesforce service expertise.

### Get Salesforce. Free.
Start fast with built-in AI and everything you need to get going — at no cost.

Starter Suite also includes AI that analyzes your video calls to automatically generate transcripts and meeting summaries.

### Start fast, see value faster.

Starter Suite gets you set up fast with guided onboarding and support — so you can start automating from day one.

### AI that sounds like you, not a chatbot.

With AI built on decades of Salesforce expertise in customer experience, every automated interaction feels personal — so the relationships you've worked hard to build only get stronger.

![A woman working on a laptop](https://wp.sfdcdigital.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2026/03/story-tab-starter-why-suites-3.jpg?w=1024)

### Know your next move, and when to make it.

Agentforce Coworker draws on your customers’ full history, behavior, and context, so you always know what to say and when to say it — across sales, marketing, and customer support.

![A woman smiling holder her phone talking to a man holding a coffee mug and coffee pot.](https://wp.sfdcdigital.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2026/03/story-tab-starter-why-suites-4.jpg?w=1024)

With AI that's built on Salesforce's enterprise-grade security and privacy standards, your customers data is in safe hands.

Move deals forward automatically with lead routing, triggered follow-ups, and activity capture — so you're focused on closing, not managing. And when you close? Send a professional invoice instantly, right from the opportunity.

With automated scoring that tells you who’s most likely to convert and a complete view of your pipeline health, deal stages, and performance, you always know where to spend your time — and where to push harder.

### The right person. Every single time.

Build segments targeting who’s most likely to buy, drop in a template, and send — your message reaches exactly the right customers, exactly when it should.

### Get your sales process humming.

Build a branded storefront with simple drag-and-drop tools and step-by-step guidance — so you can start selling without the technical headache.

### Built to sell.

Use easy merchandising tools to manage every product detail — then let built-in AI track performance, promotions, and payments so you always know what's working and where to go next.

![Screenshot with the image of a woman in the top right](https://wp.sfdcdigital.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/12/story-tab-starter-commerce-3.jpg?w=1024)

### Meet them at checkout, on any channel.

Whether it's your storefront checkout or a payment link in an email, transactions are simple — no matter where your customers choose to buy.

![Screenshot with the image of a man on the right	](https://wp.sfdcdigital.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/12/story-tab-starter-slack-1.jpg?w=1024)

### All the context, none of the switching.

With CRM data right in Slack, your team has the context they need without leaving the conversation.

![Screenshot of an image of a woman pholding a mobile phone](https://wp.sfdcdigital.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/12/story-tab-starter-slack-2.jpg?w=1024)

### Faster decisions, together.

Connect instantly with your team via audio, video, or screenshare — so you can align quickly and keep things moving.

![A screenshot with several images of people](https://wp.sfdcdigital.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/12/story-tab-starter-slack-3.jpg?w=1024)

![](https://wp.sfdcdigital.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/12/logos-bg-agentforce-for-sales.jpg?w=1024)

### What is Starter Suite?

Starter Suite is a turnkey CRM that brings sales, service, marketing, commerce, and Slack together into one application. It includes built-in AI to help you automate quality interactions you’re actually proud of, allowing your team to operate off the exact same view of the customer. Ultimately, it gives you everything you need to deliver an experience that matches your ambition—with zero complex setup required so you get value from day one.

Watch the [demo video](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/starter/) to see Starter Suite in action.

### How do I get started with Starter?

Getting started is completely turnkey. Simply [sign up for a free 30-day trial](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/free-trial/starter-suite/?d=pb) to begin exploring the platform immediately. To help you hit the ground running, take advantage of these built-in resources:

\- [Guided Checklist](https://www.salesforce.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/documents/starter/starter-suite-checklist.pdf): Follow step-by-step guidance to set up your CRM in minutes.

\- [Interactive Demos](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/onboarding-demos/): Click through and see Starter Suite's tools in action before you build.

\- [Live Workshops](https://invite.salesforce.com/suitesliveqaworkshop): Learn best practices directly from our experts in guided, interactive sessions.

When you're ready, you can easily purchase Starter Suite through our simple self-checkout.

### What can the built-in AI actually do for my business?

Agentforce Coworker acts as a built-in team member that reads, summarizes, and updates customer details, letting you spend less time on admin and more time selling. Starter Suite also includes AI that analyzes your video calls to automatically generate transcripts and meeting summaries. For example, a lean, ambitious sales team can use this to quickly prep for meetings.

### Do the AI features require technical setup?

There is zero setup required. Salesforce builds AI directly into the workflows lean teams already use. You don't need an IT department or complex integrations to get started. For example, your team can log in on day one and immediately ask the built-in assistant to draft customer responses based on past case history.

### How does Starter Suite support my business goals?

As you turn new leads into lifelong customers, Starter provides the reliable foundation your team needs. Run your sales, marketing, and service right out of the box—all seamlessly connected through Slack, where your team already works.

And when your ambition demands even deeper customization and complex automation, moving to [Pro Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/pro-suite/) is completely seamless. [Compare](https://www.salesforce.com/content/dam/web/en_us/www/documents/starter/starter-prosuite-feature-comparison.pdf) Starter and Pro to see which matches your ambition.

### How much does Starter cost?

Starter is available starting at $25 USD per user, per month, which can be billed monthly or annually. Check out [this data sheet](https://www.salesforce.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/documents/datasheets/starter-data-sheet-amer.pdf) to learn more about the features included in Starter.

Starter includes 2,000 emails per month. Plus, you can add on more as needed with the Marketing Email Sends Bundle for an additional 1,000 email sends for $10 USD per month.

Commerce functionality in Starter are subject to transaction fees. Pricing is pay-as-you-go and rates vary by region and payment method. For example, credit card payments in the U.S. are 2.9% + $0.30 USD per transaction.

### What is the difference between Pro Suite and Starter Suite?

[Pro Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/pro-suite/) includes all the capabilities and built-in AI found in Starter Suite, but adds deep, advanced customization. Teams can build custom apps, create custom objects, and access prebuilt solutions on the AgentExchange. It also provides a sandbox environment for safe testing and training. Lean teams upgrade to Pro Suite when they need complex workflow automation to match a highly specific sales cycle.

### When should a business upgrade from Starter Suite to Pro Suite?

Teams move to [Pro Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/pro-suite/) when their workflows demand deeper customization, complex automation, or external app integrations. It builds on Starter’s turnkey AI by unlocking custom objects, a testing sandbox, and advanced tools like sales forecasting—giving you the exact firepower needed to map complex sales cycles and accurately track revenue.

_This page is provided for information purposes only and subject to change. Products may not be available in all markets. For product availability contact a sales representative._

### What is AIforce?

AIforce is Salesforce's approach to bringing trusted Salesforce data and [AI](https://www.salesforce.com/artificial-intelligence/what-is-ai/) directly into the tools you already use, not just Salesforce's own screens. Instead of switching tabs, you get Salesforce's automation and intelligence wherever you're working.

### What's the difference between AIforce and things like Salesforce in Claude?

Salesforce in Claude is one specific product: a ready-made way to use [Salesforce inside Claude](https://www.salesforce.com/claudeforce/). AIforce is the bigger idea behind it: the same trusted Salesforce foundation can show up in many different tools, of which Claude is just one example.

### What's the difference between Agentforce and AIforce?

[Agentforce](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/) is Salesforce's product for building and running [AI agents](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents/) that can take action on your behalf (like handling service cases or qualifying leads) inside Salesforce. AIforce is the broader idea of bringing Salesforce's trusted data and AI (including Agentforce) into the everyday tools you already use, like Slack or Claude, instead of only inside Salesforce itself. In short: Agentforce is the AI agent technology; AIforce is how that technology (and other Salesforce capabilities) can show up anywhere you work.

### Do I need to be a developer to use it?

Ready-made experiences like Salesforce in Claude work out of the box with minimal setup required. However, our Headless Toolkit empowers your team to build something more tailored to your own workflows — but that’s optional, not required.

### Can I customize what I build with it?

Yes. If the out-of-the-box products don’t fit your needs, the Headless Toolkit lets your team build a custom experience. You can choose exactly which Salesforce features to expose and connect them to your own systems, tools, and interfaces.

### Where can I actually use AIforce?

Anywhere your team already works, including [Slack](https://www.salesforce.com/slack/), Claude, and other everyday tools, with more surfaces added over time.

### Will this work with the tools I've already built or connected?

Yes. If you've already connected your systems to Salesforce, that work carries over. You don't need to start from scratch.
